findings.label: Map key accumulation in middleware
findings.detail: requestLog Map accumulates IP keys indefinitely. Timestamp arrays are pruned but the key itself is never removed. Benign for demo traffic; worth addressing if adapted for higher-volume use.

findings.label: onError regex fragility
findings.detail: The [^}]* pattern will fail to extract the error field if a future API error string contains '}'. Current error strings are safe. If new error messages are added, verify they do not contain this character.
